bootstrap: Paired row bootstrap within each Batch x true-gas stratum. Equivalent multinomial draws of joint (prediction_A,prediction_B) cell counts preserve pairing. No Batch or chronological-block resampling; 2.5/97.5 percentile intervals. Conditional descriptive sampling uncertainty, not independent future generalization CI.
wilson: 95% Wilson score interval for class recall under binomial independence; temporal/session dependence may invalidate nominal coverage.
sensors: Reuse stage7 diagnostic top features for visualization only. All transforms use frozen Model A Train scaler; no fit or model feature changes.
selection_policy: Model A remains official main candidate; Model B remains fixed expansion comparison. No retuning, reselection, thresholds or model weighting changes.
cm_normalization: CSV retains counts; plots use row fractions: actual gas support denominator.
